commit_message: Finish ADR 0122 verification and visual fixture
pr_title: Complete ADR 0122 spatial audio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0122 spatial audio first-release requirements and closes remaining lifecycle/test coverage. The visual-validation fixture does not fabricate an unresolved audio asset and now focuses the constrained capture on the Audio Emitter/Listener Inspector while retaining Scene View spatial gizmos.

## Validation

Run fresh Windows affected validation and Spatial Audio Editor Visual Validation on the final head.
